column1: # Book 4 second-round read (Fable, 2026-10-30): every line read against the Latin.
# 4.1034 loca = places, as at 4.1047 (the two lines are near-identical in the Latin; HANDOFF item).
# (1034 first patched in the read; superseded by the gloss fix below)
# 4.938 hic idem is the air (aer, 937), not the body.
# 4.1015 doloribus = in their pain; "for their pains" is the wrong idiom.
# 4.1031 dies matura is the subject: the ripe day creates the seed; the English had made it ripen the seed.
# 4.1034 qui is singular and refers to the face and color, not the images.
